verdict: Claude Haiku 5.5 or Claude Sonnet 5 for packets. On DocSplit both got 0.71 of sections exactly right, against 0.51 for the default, Amazon Nova 2 Lite, and classified more pages correctly (0.86 and 0.89, against 0.82). They used about three times the classification tokens (about 8,800 per page, against 2,850) and about 37% more total tokens. Amazon Nova Pro scored below the default.
